title: Keeping Humans in the Loop: Human-Centered Automated Annotation with Generative AI
reasoning: The paper focuses on a methodological framework for human-centered automated annotation using LLMs. While it benchmarks performance on a classification task involving 'religious groups' as part of a broad set of 27 social science tasks, its primary objective is the reliability and workflow of annotation rather than a specialized evaluation of religious, moral, or ethical reasoning.
